title: Sorry to see you go: 4 minutes to tell us why you left {product}
description: A short exit survey for customers who cancelled or downgraded {product}. Your reasons decide what the {team} fixes first.
audience: Customers who cancelled or downgraded their {product} subscription in the last 30 days
purpose: Decide which top two churn reasons to address next quarter, and which ones are fixable versus out of our control

welcome.title: Help us understand why you left

thank_you.title: Thank you, that really helps
thank_you.description: We read every answer and review the reasons each month. If you agreed to a call, we'll email you within a week. Questions? {contact}

questions.label: What did you change about your {product} subscription in the last 30 days?
options: Nothing, I'm on the same plan

jumps.when: Q1 is 'Nothing, I'm on the same plan'

questions.label: What was the main reason you made this change?
questions.description: Pick the one that mattered most.

questions.label: Did you move to another product instead of {product}?
Which product did you move to?
Which feature were you missing?
questions.shown_when: Q2 is 'Missing a feature I need'

questions.label: Overall, how satisfied or dissatisfied were you with {product} before you made this change?
Before deciding, which of these did you try? Select all that apply.
How long had you been a customer, in months?
What one thing could we have done to keep you as a customer?
Would you be open to a 15-minute call with the {team} about your experience?
Which email address can we use to arrange the call?
questions.description: We'll use it only to schedule this one call.

questions.label: How many people work at your organisation?
questions.description: So we can see whether reasons differ by organisation size.
